title: Foxy's Mod
description: Some fun additions to Minecraft 1.21.1 with Create Mod purposefully built for the Just Create SMP.
body:
# Foxy's Mod

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1 | **Mod Loader:** NeoForge

Foxy's Mod is for fun. It is intentionally "broken" adding intentional flaws into entities and features "on accident".

## Features
### The Bank & Economy System
Foxy's Mod introduces a fully functional, highly secure, global diamond economy that allows players to store their wealth, trade goods, and claim bounties!

* **The Bank Block:** The central hub for the economy. Players can deposit or withdraw Diamonds and Diamond Blocks, set up a secure PIN code, and view their lifetime account stats.
* **Passive Interest:** Storing your diamonds in the bank isn't just secure—it's profitable! Accounts accrue interest over time, allowing your stored wealth to passively grow.
* **Dynamic Trading & Bounties:** Through the Bank UI, players can trade specific farmable items for diamond rewards, or claim server-wide bounties by depositing the player heads of their targets!
* **The ATM:** A portable access point that players can purchase from the Bank. Place it anywhere in the world to access your funds remotely.
* **Redstone & Comparators:** When a security alarm is active, the Bank Block emits a full-strength (15) redstone signal and analog output. This is perfect for wiring up hidden blast doors, lockdown sirens, or secret deployment hatches!

### The Security Bot & Lasers
The bank is heavily guarded. If a player triggers a Security Alert (by guessing a PIN incorrectly, trying to buy things without enough funds, or submitting fake bounty items), they are slapped with a criminal debt and given 10 seconds to pay it off. If they fail, the Security Bot deploys.

* **Predictive Laser Aiming:** The bot is armed with dual-barrel lasers. It tracks a player's exact 3D velocity and leads its shots, perfectly sniping players even if they are sprinting or flying with an Elytra.
* **Relentless Pursuit:** The bot dynamically adjusts its movement speed to match its target.
* **Hydraulic Super-Jump & Door Breaching:** You cannot hide. The bot can naturally pathfind through closed doors (opening them like a Villager) and features a brute-force hydraulic jump that allows it to launch itself over 3-block-high walls if it gets stuck.
* **Un-Capturable:** The bot cannot be trapped. It will completely ignore Minecarts and Boats, and will instantly shatter Create Mod seats if a machine tries to scoop it up.
* **Custom Deployment Zones:** Base builders rejoice! Before placing a Bank Block, players can Sneak + Right-Click any block in the world to bind the Security Bot's spawn point to that exact location.

### Create Mod Integration
Foxy's Mod features deep, native integration with the Create Mod to make your factories and shopping districts feel alive!

* **Automated Shopping Lists:** If you right-click an ATM while holding a Create Mod `Shopping List`, the ATM will automatically scan the loaded shops on the list, calculate the exact diamond cost, seamlessly withdraw the funds from your digital bank account, and place the physical diamonds in your inventory so you can complete the purchase!
* **Display Link Support:** You can attach a Create Mod Display Link directly to the Bank Block to pull live server statistics and broadcast them to Display Boards! Use the UI cycle menu to display:
    * **The Rich List:** Automatically updates and ranks the Top 3 wealthiest players on the server.
    * **Total Server Wealth:** Displays the combined diamond count of every account on the server.
    * **Active Bounties:** Lists all currently unclaimed player bounties and their rewards.
    * **Richest Player:** Displays the player with the most diamonds held in the bank.

### The Baby Shicken
It can be found roaming the world or spawned in via its custom Spawn Egg in the Creative Inventory. It possesses several highly customized AI behaviors:

* **The Stalker AI:** Baby Shickens will actively hunt living entities down, but they won't attack immediately. They prefer to stop a few blocks away and just... stare.
* **Ticking Time Bombs:** Once a Shicken begins stalking you, a hidden timer starts. They will wait anywhere from 30 to 90 seconds before snapping and moving in for the kill.
* **Enderman Trigger:** If you lose your nerve and look directly at a stalking Baby Shicken, it will instantly provoke, drop the timer, and sprint at you.
* **Swallowed Whole:** The Baby Shicken features a custom, fully animated attack. It will tilt its head back, shoot out a long tongue to grab the player, and swallow them whole, complete with a custom death message.
* **The Hydra Effect:** Think you can just punch it away? If a player damages a Baby Shicken with a weak attack and fails to kill it, it will instantly duplicate itself.

### The Sulfur Cube
It can be found spawning in caves or spawned in via its custom Spawn Egg in the Creative Inventory. It mimics the Sulfur Cube from 26.2 Snapshot 3.

* **Slimeball Craving:** The Sulfur Cube's targeting system is completely peaceful. Babies will actively track and follow players who are holding Slime Balls.
* **Block Absorption:** Right-clicking the cube with a solid, full block will cause it to absorb the item. This transforms the mob into an interactive, physics-enabled Sulfur Cube Ball.
* **Dynamic Physics:** The physics of the Sulfur Cube Ball change entirely depending on what block is trapped inside. Wood creates a bouncy rubber ball, Ice creates a frictionless hockey puck, and heavy metals create a high-resistance medicine ball.
* **Kinetic Impacts:** If you hit the ball with an empty hand, a block, or a projectile, the ball will launch away based on your momentum. However, hitting the ball with a weapon will violently launch the *player* backward instead!
* **Explosive Payload:** If you feed the cube a block of TNT, it becomes a volatile explosive. Damaging the TNT ball will trigger a localized, block-safe explosion that launches players and entities away.
* **Tool Interactions:** Made a mistake? You can right-click the ball with Shears to pop the block back out, or use a Bucket to scoop the entire ball up for easy transport.

## Glowing Blocks
Deploy glow ink sacs onto Concrete or Stained Glass to make Glowing Concrete / Glowing Stained Glass and make your world shine

## Grates & Crates
Various create inspired grate blocks and crate blocks have been added which can be crafted on the stonecutter.
Wooden variants of crates have also been added.

## Requirements
* **Minecraft:** Java Edition 1.21.1
* **NeoForge:** Version 21.1.222 or higher
* **Create Mod:** (Optional, but required for Display Link and Shopping List features)

## Installation

1. Ensure you have the correct version of **NeoForge** installed for Minecraft 1.21.1.
2. Download the latest `foxysmod-[version].jar` file.
3. Press `Win + R`, type `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods`, and hit Enter to open your mods folder.
    * *(Mac users: `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods`)*
4. Drop the `.jar` file into the `mods` folder.
5. Launch Minecraft using the NeoForge profile.
